watches.summary: Wake just past noon; brief cell search and listening pause, then a ten-minute detection ritual.
About 2 p.m. before and 2–3 afterward; later breakdown gives one hour searching and thirty seconds fighting.
Rest lasts 1½–2 hours, ending about 3 p.m.; earlier 2–3 p.m. report leaves its starting watch open.
Later planning is about 4 p.m.; the barracks approach follows in late afternoon.
